entries.en: Click to see "How to Gift" Details

entries.zh: 可能跳跃的最大数值\n随着道具装备情况和技能的不同而改变。
entries.en: A character's jump ability can increase upto 123%. \nCan be changed through equipment item options or skills.

entries.zh: 移动到指定图。如果指定的玩家和你在同一频道，可以移动到该玩家当前所在图，部分特殊地图和跨岛移动不能进行。
entries.en: Teleports to the map of your choice, or to the map where the chosen character is.

entries.zh: 把目前角色所在地区纪录到瞬间移动列表。最多可以纪录10个。
entries.en: Registers the map where the character is located into the Teleport List. Can register upto 10 different places.

entries.zh: 想要把进行中的任务登记到任务公告栏里，请点击任务公告栏按钮。最多可登记5个任务。
entries.en: Click on Quest Alarm button if you wish to register the current quest into the Quest Alarm. Up to 5 quests can be registered in this alarm.

entries.zh: 用现金可以购买既可爱又好看的装饰类道具、\n聊天道具、美发店会员卡、整形手术卡等多种\n的物品。
entries.en: It's a place where, armed with Cash, you'll be able to purchase accessories, clothes, messenger item, hair salon coupons, coupons for plastic surgery, and other various items.

entries.zh: 看所有物品列表的界面\n背包（物品窗）里有装备、消耗品、设置、其他道具。
entries.en: The window that allows the character to see the items it owns.\nThe items are categorized under Equip., Use, Set-Up, and Etc. items.

entries.zh: 察看道具装备情况，穿、脱道具的界面\n和物品栏一起使用可装备道具。
entries.en: The window that shows the equipped items, and allowing the character to equip/unequip them.\nOpen the item inventory alongside it to use the equip. items.

entries.zh: 察看角色的详细情况和能力值的界面\n用AP可以提高多种能力值。
entries.en: The window that shows detailed character info and its abilities.\nUse AP to enhance many different kinds of abilities.

entries.zh: 可以察看各种技能的详细内容\n通过消耗技能点可以学习专门的技能。
entries.en: The window that shows the detailed look of the skillbook owned by the character.\nUse skill points to learn the skills available.

entries.zh: 与同区好友进行交流的界面。
entries.en: The window that lets you chat with buddies within a world.

entries.zh: 更改游戏设置和察看游戏情况的界面。\n可以更改游戏设置，系统参数可以察看\n任务情报，组队情况，社区信息。
entries.en: The window that lets you change the options or game infos.\nCan change game and system option.\nCan also see quest info, party info, and the community info.

entries.zh: 增加地图，最多增加5个。使用缩地石可以瞬间移动到目录中的地图。
entries.en: Registers the map the character is at to the teleport list. Can save up to 5 maps.
Delete the chosen map from the list.

entries.zh: 根据目前的等级和职业，适当地分配属性值。
entries.en: Distributes the remaining AP according to your level and class.

entries.zh: 根据拳手职业自动分配剩余的属性值
entries.en: Distributes the remaining AP according to Brawler requirements.

entries.zh: 根据枪手职业自动分配剩余的属性值
entries.en: Distributes the remaining AP according to Gunslinger requirements.

entries.zh:
是决定物理攻击的破坏的能力值。可以决定战
士和魔法师的力量，弓箭手的敏捷性，飞侠的
力量、敏捷性和运气，海盗的力量和敏捷性。
上面的能力值和装备的物理攻击力合起来决定
了物理攻击力。
entries.en: Once the name is made,\nthe name can't be changed.

entries.zh: 防御一般攻击的能力值\n由角色装备的所有防御道具的防御能力来\n决定。
entries.en:
Can make the job advancement to Warrior, Bowman, Thief, Magician, or Pirate. 
Warrior : Minimum of Level 10, Perion
Bowman : Minimum of Level 10, Henesys
Magician : Minimum of Level 8, Ellinia
Thief : Minimum of Level 10, Kerning City
Pirate : Minimum of Level 10, The Nautilus

entries.zh: 使用魔法成功率和魔法攻击力的能力值\n由角色装备道具的魔力和智力来决定。
entries.en: Accumulate enough EXP to raise the level of the character.

entries.zh: 防御魔法攻击的能力值\n由角色装备的所有魔法防御道具魔法防御力来\n决定。
entries.en: The main community of the communities the account belongs to. Press "G" to check guild info.

entries.zh: 决定一般攻击命中率的能力值\n命中率高一般攻击更有效\n由敏捷度和所装备的道具来决定。
entries.en: It's a health stat, and if it reaches 0, the character dies.\nHP decreases if either attacked by an enemy or if a certain skill is used.\nIt can go up to the maximum of 30,000 points.

entries.zh: 回避一般攻击的能力值\n数值越高，回避攻击率越高\n由敏捷度，运气，道具装备的情况来决定。
entries.en: The stat needed to use various skills.\nIt can go up to the maximum of 30,000 points.

entries.zh: 影响攻击、技能的熟练度，使得输出伤害更加\n稳定精准。
entries.en: The amount of experience gained. \nObtained by killing a monster or completing a quest.

entries.zh: 随着道具装备情况和技能的不同而改变。
entries.en: The level of fame can be increased or decreased, based on other users. Some equipments and quests require the character reach a certain level of fame.

entries.zh:
随着这个能力值升高命中率和回血率都会增加
。是决定弓箭手和海盗（火枪手）的攻击力的
最重要的能力值。该值通过AP加点获得最大
值为999。
entries.en: This stat is vital to making direct attacks using a weapon. This is the most significant stat when it comes to the strength of the attacks for warriors and pirates (Gunslingers).

entries.zh: 智力值越高，魔法攻击的威力就越高\n是决定魔法师魔力的关键。该值通过AP加点\n获得最大值为999。
entries.en: The higher this stat, the higher the accuracy and strenghth of your magic attack. The most important stat that determines the magic attacks for mages.

entries.zh:
运气值越高，敏捷也会增加。
是决定飞侠攻击力和技能的关键
这个值越高死亡时下降的经验值越少。
该值通过AP加点获得最大值为999。
entries.en: The higher it is, the higher the avoidability is. \nIt determines the Thief's attacking ability and the Mage's magic attack accuracy. \nAlso, the higher it is, the less EXP a character loses by dying.

entries.zh:
提高力量，敏捷，智力，运气和HP，MP等的
数值。提高力量，敏捷，智力，运气时使用能
力值1，增加的能力也是1，但提高HP，MP与
各角色的状态有关。每个角色都不同。升级的
时候给玩家5点能力值，累积满255点后将无
法获得更多点数。
entries.en: Amount to increase STR, DEX, INT,LUK, HP and MP. For STR, DEX, INT and LUK, every 1 AP used will increase the stats by 1.  For HP and MP, it differs pending on the jobs and characters.  5 Points will be given upon level up.

entries.zh: 武器商店·杂货商店·玩具城车站
购买角色已装备的物品\n不包括原来所有的物品.
entries.en: Buying the items that are equipped by the character. The existing items are not\nincluded in the purchase.

entries.zh: 恢复到进入商城前的状态.
entries.en: Character being put back into the state of default before walking into the cash shop.

entries.zh: 退购用点券购买的道具可按一定比率增加抵用券.
entries.en: Deleting cash items and saving a percentage of its price as MaplePoints

entries.zh: 扩展4个(一行)装备栏的格子.\n8000点券
entries.en: Extending an equip. inventory by 4 slots (1 line)\n8000 A-Cash

entries.zh: 增加4个(一行)消耗栏格子.\n8000点券
entries.en: Extending a use inventory by 4 slots (1 line)\n8000 A-Cash

entries.zh: 增加4个(一行)设置栏格子.\n8000点券
entries.en: Extending a set-up inventory by 4 slots (1 line)\n8000 A-Cash

entries.zh: 增加4个(一行)其他栏的格子.\n8000点券
entries.en: Extending an etc. inventory by 4 slots (1 line)\n8000 A-Cash

entries.zh: 请访问网站充值您的帐户.
entries.en: Please visit the website to charge your account.

entries.zh: 用持有的道具优惠券兑换道具.
entries.en: Exchanging the item coupon into an item.

entries.zh: 脱去角色穿着的所有道具.
entries.en: Remove all the items that the character is wearing.
